prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1498; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's alright.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision took place?

A: It was on the freeway in Pasadena, Texas, in the right-hand lane heading toward the interchange. Traffic was moving fairly steadily.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?

A: I was changing lanes to the left because I needed to get over for my exit. I checked my mirror and looked over my shoulder, and I didn't see anything beside me.

Q: Did you use your turn signal?

A: Yes, I put my signal on before I moved over.

Q: What happened next?

A: I started to drift over and then I heard a loud bang and felt my car get pushed. The other vehicle had come up in my blind spot, and we sideswiped each other. My side mirror was knocked off and the rear passenger door got scraped up.

Q: Did you stop after the collision?

A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder right away. The other driver stopped too and we exchanged information.

Q: Were you injured?

A: My neck hurts quite a bit. I felt it jerk when the car got pushed, and by the next morning it was stiff and sore. I'm having trouble turning my head to the right and I've had headaches on and off.

Q: Have you sought medical attention?

A: Yes, I went to a clinic and they told me I have a neck strain. I'm taking anti-inflammatories and doing some stretches.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add?

A: Only that I was being careful and I'm hoping this gets sorted out quickly, because I need the car for work.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
